description: A middle-aged man with grey-brown hair and rolled shirtsleeves, wearing a dark waistcoat, holds up a heavy metal type block bearing a capital A in a dim, brick-walled workshop. Foreground trays hold more metal type, some ornate with scrollwork. A wooden board behind him reads HAND PRESSED with smaller lettering, and a partial word RAW appears at top right. The painting is full-bleed, with no frame or border visible.
